kick a habit: It is never easy to kick a habit like smoking, but my uncle finally did it last year.
戒掉像抽菸這樣的習慣從來都不容易，但我叔叔去年終於做到了。
kick off the meeting: The manager will kick off the meeting by introducing the two new members of our team.
經理將以介紹我們團隊的兩位新成員來開始會議。
kick someone out: The bar owner had to kick a drunk man out after he started fighting with other customers.
那名醉漢開始和其他客人打架後，酒吧老闆不得不把他趕走。
kick in: Take this medicine, and it should kick in within thirty minutes to stop your headache.
吃下這個藥，它應該會在三十分鐘內開始生效，止住你的頭痛。
kick oneself: I could kick myself for forgetting my best friend's birthday again this year.
我今年又忘了最好朋友的生日，真是懊悔不已。
get a kick out of: Little kids always get a kick out of watching the monkeys play at the zoo.
小孩子總是能從觀看動物園裡的猴子玩耍中得到樂趣。
kidnap a child: The police caught the man who had tried to kidnap a child outside the elementary school.
警方抓到了那名企圖在小學外面綁架小孩的男子。
be kidnapped for ransom: Rich families sometimes hire bodyguards because they fear their children might be kidnapped for ransom.
有錢人家有時會雇用保鑣，因為他們擔心孩子可能會被綁架勒贖。
kill time: While waiting for the delayed train, I played games on my phone to kill time.
等待誤點的火車時，我在手機上玩遊戲來打發時間。
kill two birds with one stone: By riding my bike to school, I kill two birds with one stone: I save money and get exercise.
騎腳踏車上學讓我一石二鳥：既省錢又能運動。
kill the mood: We were having a great time at the party, but his rude joke seemed to kill the mood.
我們在派對上玩得很開心，但他粗魯的笑話似乎破壞了氣氛。
kill a bill: Many lawmakers voted against it, hoping to kill a bill that would raise taxes for small shops.
許多立法委員投下反對票，希望否決一項會提高小商店稅金的法案。
kill the engine: When you stop at the gas station, please kill the engine before filling up the tank.
當你在加油站停車時，請先熄火再加油。
kill the pain: The doctor gave me some strong medicine to kill the pain after my tooth was pulled.
我拔完牙後，醫生給了我一些強效藥物來止痛。
dressed to kill: Wearing a red dress and high heels, Lisa arrived at the party dressed to kill.
莉莎穿著紅色洋裝和高跟鞋，盛裝打扮地抵達派對。
kindle interest: The science teacher used fun experiments to kindle interest in chemistry among her students.
那位自然老師用有趣的實驗來激發學生對化學的興趣。
kindle hope: Finding one survivor under the fallen building was enough to kindle hope among the tired rescue workers.
在倒塌的建築物下找到一名生還者，足以在疲憊的救難人員之間燃起希望。
kindle a fire: On our camping trip, we used dry leaves and small sticks to kindle a fire.
露營旅行時，我們用乾樹葉和小樹枝來生火。
kneel before the king: In the old days, everyone had to kneel before the king to show their respect.
在古時候，每個人都必須跪在國王面前以示尊敬。
kneel down to pray: Every night before going to bed, my grandmother would kneel down to pray for her family.
每天晚上睡前，我奶奶都會跪下祈禱，為家人祈福。
kneel in protest: Instead of standing during the song, several players chose to kneel in protest against unfair treatment.
幾名球員在歌曲播放時沒有站立，而是選擇下跪抗議不公平的待遇。
knit the community together: The yearly street festival helps knit the community together as neighbors cook and celebrate side by side.
一年一度的街頭節慶讓鄰居們並肩烹飪、慶祝，有助於凝聚社區。
knit one's brows: My brother always knits his brows when he tries to solve a difficult math problem.
我弟弟在試著解困難的數學題時，總是皺眉。
a closely knit family: I grew up in a closely knit family, so we always eat dinner together and share our problems.
我在一個關係緊密的家庭中長大，所以我們總是一起吃晚餐，分享彼此的問題。
knit a sweater: My grandmother used two long needles and soft wool to knit a sweater for my birthday.
我奶奶用兩根長棒針和柔軟的毛線，為我的生日織了一件毛衣。
tie the knot: After dating for five years, Jack and Mary finally decided to tie the knot next spring.
交往五年後，傑克和瑪莉終於決定明年春天結婚。
a knot in one's stomach: Before going on stage to give my speech, I felt a knot in my stomach because I was so nervous.
上台發表演講前，我非常緊張，緊張得胃打結。
knot a tie: My father taught me how to knot a tie the night before my first job interview.
在我第一次工作面試的前一晚，爸爸教我如何打領帶。
knotted muscles: After sitting at his desk all day, he went for a massage to loosen his knotted muscles.
整天坐在書桌前之後，他去按摩來放鬆僵硬的肌肉。
